# Hylex Energy Consulting

> Global fabrication, procurement, engineering and project delivery for EPC companies and asset owners. Hylex takes ownership of the fabrication execution process from shop readiness and sourcing through QA, NDE, FAT and logistics, delivered through fabrication and engineering hubs in China, Vietnam and Mexico, with headquarters in the Energy Corridor, Houston, Texas.

## Key facts
- Four services: engineering and design, global procurement, fabrication delivery, project controls and lifecycle reporting
- Houston holds the client interface, engineering coordination, procurement and QA; the hubs hold the capacity, the yards and the load out
- Capacity attribution: every tonnage, dia-inch and square metre figure below is nameplate capacity declared by the partner workshops and checked on audit. It is capacity available to a Hylex managed program, not Hylex output, and Hylex does not own the yards
- Pipe spooling over 250,000 dia-inches a month across the workshops
- Structural steel and platework over 50,000 tons a year
- Pressure vessels and columns to 8 m diameter and 150 mm wall, single units over 300 tons
- Pre assembled modules 1,000 to 3,000 tons and up to 32 m long
- Over 16,000 m2 of surface preparation and coating, including TSA, FBE, epoxy and galvanizing
- Over 500 prequalified manufacturers and OEMs; strategic sourcing gives an indicative 20 to 40 percent saving against local procurement, priced per scope rather than guaranteed
- Fabricated and tested to ASME, API, PED, EN, ISO, NORSOK M-501 and ISO 12944
- China hub: over 200,000 dia-inches a month, over 40,000 tons a year structural, modules to 3,000 tons
- Vietnam hub: 195,000 m2 yard, 31,000 m2 covered workshops, 260 t gantry cranes, 312 m private jetty with 10,000 DWT load out
- Mexico hub: Monterrey, 4,000 to 5,000 spools a month, 34,000 factored dia-inches a week, 11 hectare yard, 100,000 sq ft coating facility, inside USMCA
- Sectors: chemical, LNG terminals, downstream, power, mining and semiconductor
- Separate line of work: industrial AI systems for estimating, sales pipeline, shop floor tracking and a private agent on the client's own server
- Every enquiry is handled by a principal, answered within one working day

- [Fabrication Capability: Spools, Vessels, Modules | Hylex](https://www.hylexenergy.com/capability): Pipe spooling, structural steel, pressure vessels to 8 m diameter and modules over 1,000 tons, with integrated QA, NDE and digital progress reporting.
- [Global Fabrication Network, Houston to Asia | Hylex](https://www.hylexenergy.com/network): Houston headquarters with fabrication and engineering hubs in China, Vietnam and Mexico: capacity, yards, load out and trade position for EPC and owner work.
- [China Fabrication and Engineering Hub | Hylex Energy](https://www.hylexenergy.com/hub-china): The China hub: over 200,000 dia-inches of pipe spooling a month, 40,000 tons a year of structural steel, vessels to 8 m diameter and modules to 3,000 tons.
- [Vietnam Fabrication and Engineering Hub | Hylex Energy](https://www.hylexenergy.com/hub-vietnam): The Vietnam hub: a 195,000 m² yard with a 312 m private jetty, 260 t gantry cranes, 20,000 tons a year of structural steel and 180,000 dia-inches of spooling.
- [Mexico Fabrication Hub at Monterrey | Hylex Energy](https://www.hylexenergy.com/hub-mexico): The Monterrey hub: 4,000 to 5,000 spools a month, 34,000 factored dia-inches a week, an 11 hectare yard and a 100,000 sq ft coating facility, inside USMCA.
- [Project Controls and Expediting for Fabrication | Hylex](https://www.hylexenergy.com/digital): Weld inch tracking, progress by piece and by weight from the shop records, NDE against the ITP, material traceability and a digital manufacturing record book.
- [Industrial AI for Fabrication and Procurement | Hylex](https://www.hylexenergy.com/industrial-ai): Estimating and take off, sales pipeline, shop floor tracking and a private AI agent on your own server, set up for fabricators, suppliers and distributors.
- [About Hylex Energy Consulting | Houston, Texas](https://www.hylexenergy.com/about): Hylex Energy Consulting, Energy Corridor, Houston TX: end to end fabrication program management for EPC companies and asset owners through a global network.

- [Contact Hylex Energy | Request a Fabrication Quote](https://www.hylexenergy.com/contact): Houston TX and Tianjin, China. Send drawings, specifications or a material list for fabrication and procurement pricing, and we reply within one working day.
- [Insights on Fabrication Sourcing | Hylex Energy](https://www.hylexenergy.com/insights): Notes on sourcing fabricated equipment from Asia and Mexico: landed pricing, reading bid packages, vendor qualification and project control systems.
- [What a Landed Price from Asia Should Include | Hylex](https://www.hylexenergy.com/insight-landed-price-from-asia): Seven cost lines that separate a real delivered price from a shop quote, and how to compare offers from Asia fairly before you award the fabrication.
- [Reading a 300 Page Bid Package in a Day | Hylex Energy](https://www.hylexenergy.com/insight-reading-a-bid-package): AI reads every page and cites it, a person checks the result, and what comes out is a scope sheet a fabricator can actually price without a second pass.
